Why do you scan for the exit everywhere you go?
It is not fear. It is road sense, an old Andromedan gift for keeping a way open.
But half of you stands at the door, and that is why you leave rooms tired.
Comment DOOR if you always find the exit first, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
